_comment: Cloak rooms and paid lounges at stations already on the site. Only stations a source names get a fact; a station that isn't here shows 'No data yet', never 'not available'. Each fact lists its source keys (from 'sources') and the date it was checked. 'station' uses the site's name (aliases from station_names.json work); add 'division' if the name is in two divisions. scraper/build.py stops with an error if a station, amenity or source key doesn't match. Lounge = an executive lounge or an AC waiting lounge you pay to use; free waiting halls don't count. Most sources are news reports quoting the railways, so notes give the report's date.
